summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Bansi Vihar luxury restaurant single-page website. All major sections render correctly, all 6 signature items, 6 gallery items, 6 review cards present. Loader fades after ~3s, navbar becomes glassmorphic on scroll, smooth anchor navigation works, hero counters/CTAs work, Contact tel:/wa.me/Maps links use correct URLs, Google Map iframe loads, footer renders socials. Site is responsive on desktop (1920), tablet (768), and mobile (390). One observed flaky issue: the mobile drawer did not appear visible during automated toggle test (mobile nav link selector timeout) — likely a Framer-Motion height-animation timing issue but main agent should verify manually.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=nav-mobile-toggle] on 390px viewport, drawer mobile links (nav-link-{key}-mobile) were not visible/found within 30s. Could be Framer-Motion height animation timing or click not registering. Worth manual verification.

action_items: Manually verify mobile menu (hamburger toggle) on a real mobile viewport — drawer should open with menu links and Reserve CTA. If broken, ensure onClick toggle handler fires and AnimatePresence mounts the drawer; consider adding aria-expanded for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx renders <Loader> unconditionally even after ready=true; once Loader unmounts via AnimatePresence internally it's fine, but parent could conditionally render to free memory.

Hero headline contains 'pure veg' inside a on a new
line which yields concatenated text 'Patna's most lovedpure veg restaurant.' without space when reading textContent — visually fine but accessibility tools may concatenate awkwardly. Consider adding aria-label.
Map iframe has heavy CSS filter (invert/hue-rotate) for dark theme — may reduce map readability/contrast for low-vision users.
Loader timing (2600ms visible + 800ms fade) is hardcoded; consider waiting for window 'load' event for slow networks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is single-page scroll layout at https://culinary-vihar.preview.emergentagent.com . Loader takes ~3s. All sections have data-testids per /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js. Verified: loader, navbar glass-on-scroll, anchor smooth scroll, 6 signature items, story, 6 gallery items, 9,680+/4.1/38 counters, 6 review cards, tel:+916122348876, wa.me/919431045221, maps iframe, footer socials. Only mobile drawer toggle needs manual verification.
